# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a single-file browser-native mobile portrait interactive novel called "Neon Afterglow: Read Receipts." Preserve the mechanic truth of a tap-to-advance chat story: the player taps to reveal nine scripted messages, then chooses between two branch buttons, receives branch-specific ending copy, and can replay. Present it as an Euphoria-inspired neon teen-drama nightlife phone confessional about emotional chaos, identity crisis, toxic romance, vulnerability, digital intimacy, and glittery melancholy. Use procedural CSS/canvas neon skyline, mascara/blue-heart focal iconography, readable chat bubbles, large touch targets, safe-area portrait layout, catalog-approved Orbitron/Exo 2 fonts, catalog-approved romantic/melancholic SFX, and compact feedback GIFs.

# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first interactive novel / chat-choice game.
- objective: Tap through a scripted teen social-drama message thread, then choose one of two romantic/emotional outcomes.
- input model: Primary pointer/touch tap advances one message at a time; overlay buttons select branch A/B; replay button restarts the same loop.
- core loop: boot into chat, tap to reveal sequential messages, reach choice overlay, select one branch, view ending, optionally replay.
- fail/friction state: No traditional loss; friction comes from delayed unread-message reveal, emotionally consequential branch choice, and restart after ending.

## Protected mechanics
- Sequential tap-to-advance chat progression and message counter semantics.
- Two mutually exclusive branch buttons after the script is exhausted.
- Ending/modal state with branch-specific result copy and replay path.
- Pointer/touch controls scoped so mobile CTA taps are not swallowed by global progression.
- Canvas ambient loop remains decorative only and does not affect mechanics.
- User-gesture-safe audio unlock; audio failures remain non-blocking.

## Remixed target
Neon Afterglow: Read Receipts reframes the same chat-choice loop as a hyper-stylized nightlife teen-drama narrative about vulnerability, toxic attraction, digital intimacy, and glittery melancholy. The focal identity is a neon mascara/blue-heart phone confessional. Messages become emotional pressure, branch choices become two incompatible intimacy fantasies, the score meter becomes vulnerability progress, and the background becomes an authored animated neon city/bathroom-mirror space optimized for portrait mobile play.
